goal: The task agent's ClaudeAgentOptions is built from the resolved SandboxPolicy via a build_agent_options seam, byte-identical under the fast preset and changing when a non-fast policy is injected.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00037-sandbox-config-foundation.md -- SC-1 (back-compat golden), SC-5 (live-wire), SC-6 (purity/optional-SDK), and the fast baseline table

packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/workflow.py -- _make_claude_code_invoke (the ClaudeAgentOptions site at line ~449) and run_task_object; extract build_agent_options and thread the sandbox primitives here
packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_sandbox_policy_wiring.py -- the held-out oracle for this task; make it green, do not edit it
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- threads the policy into run_task_object; decompose policy.sandbox into primitives here
references: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/workflow.py -- the existing `model` knob threads policy -> options as a plain primitive (run_task_object -> _make_claude_code_invoke -> ClaudeAgentOptions); mirror that exact path for the sandbox primitives
constraints: Expose build_agent_options(sandbox, *, model, max_turns, permission_mode, skills, allowed_tools, denied_tools, setting_sources, mcp_servers, mcp_strict) -> ClaudeAgentOptions and call it from _make_claude_code_invoke, so the construction has one tested home.

The sandbox config reaches the option site as PLAIN PRIMITIVES (str/tuple/dict/bool/int/float). No ClaudeAgentOptions or claude_agent_sdk type may appear in the signatures of WorkPolicy, HarnessConfig, orchestrate, or run_task_object -- preserving `import flywheel_core` without the [claude] extra.

Under the fast preset the constructed options must be byte-identical to today (same set fields, same values); omit fields at their unset sentinel -- notably leave setting_sources unset so the SDK keeps deriving it from skills=all.

Scope the live-wire to the task-agent invocation site only; leave the rubric-judge, recovery-summarizer, and hello-example ClaudeAgentOptions sites unchanged (judge/recovery profiles are a later increment).
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not change agent behavior in any way under the default (fast) config.
Do not wire the judge, recovery-summarizer, or example option sites.
Do not implement secrets scoping, budget ceilings, teardown, or network enforcement.
Do not modify files under tests/; do not weaken or delete assertions in the held-out oracle or the existing suite.
edge_cases: Injecting a policy with skills != 'all' or permission_mode != 'bypassPermissions' must change the constructed options (proves the path is live, not dead).
A flywheel.toml with [sandbox] setup only resolves to fast and changes nothing about the agent invocation.
setting_sources stays omitted under fast so the SDK's skills-derived default is preserved.
